title: Sources of the conflicting input apps (compat/conflicting-apps.json)
description: PLT-R399, PRD-R40 screen 5, CLR-R5. One entry per other Vietnamese input method: the bundle IDs that compat/rules.json lists in conflictingInputApps and where each was read (the running app, for example `lsappinfo info -only bundleid`, or public vendor documentation), never from another input method's source or bundle internals.
